scope: Independent focused FX/Modern development review on pinned capture binary and inventory; final packaging/native/release qualification is separate.
status: No production correction indicated in the two reviewed risks.
binary_and_inventory_authority: Binary was copied before capture. The captured inventory, not any later live master-level table, identifies exact render parameters. All seven current render FNV64 digests match their captured 200-value inventory vectors.
findings: Wind retains a sustained, air-band noise role while its fitted 0.7 Hz envelope component falls from baseline 2.8218 dB to 0.6012 dB peak-to-peak under identical note, velocity and sample-rate conditions. This focused metric supports substantially less periodic throbbing, not a perceptual equivalence claim.

Surf and Thunder are separate events per note: late held RMS is 56.56 dB and 64.29 dB below their 20 ms crests, while Wind and Rain remain within 2.89 dB and 2.11 dB of their crests. Thunder crests early at 0.25 s; Surf crests later at 1.83 s. Spectral centroids distinguish low rumble, air, rain and bright surf spray at the selected 1-2 s window.

Arp Poly has 25 detected audible attacks from 0.379 to 3.379 seconds; linear attack timing measures 8.00010 Hz. Bells and Bass retain conspicuous repeated attacks but their raw flux peaks include echo or timbre-motion displacement; these estimates are not used as exact clock tests.
All four explicit modern arp mode/rate/octave tuples match HEAD: Up/8/2, UpDown/4/2, Up/6/1 and Random/6/2.

Engine source routes effective panel HP/LP cutoffs through the added body filter and applies LFO amplitude and pan downstream to the combined voice. Named modern modulation therefore remains connected. A15 independently measured 1 Hz panning and 4 Hz tremolo on identical Fx/Modern/body/Engine source hashes; these are reused evidence, not A28 captures.

Robot Voice, ring-modulated effects, Siren, Helicopter and Clockwork intentionally retain their electronic or periodic character. No blanket smoothing or de-robotizing change was requested or applied to those named effects.

source_review.body_modulation_order: Body excitation -> effective panel HP/LP -> combined VCA level including lfoAmp -> pan including lfoPan. Arpeggiator remains upstream of note articulation.

measurement_methods.nature_envelope: 20 ms stereo RMS windows; late RMS over 8.0-9.5 seconds divided by largest 20 ms window.
measurement_methods.wind_periodic_component: Least-squares fit to RMS dB over 2.5-9.8 s with offset, linear/quadratic trend and sine/cosine at 0.7 Hz. Report two times fitted amplitude. No statistical confidence claim; short stochastic records are not IID.
measurement_methods.nature_spectrum: Welch spectral centroid of mean stereo channels over 1-2 seconds, 4096-frame segments, 48 kHz.
measurement_methods.arp_timing: Positive difference of 2 ms stereo RMS; peak distance 0.72 nominal periods and prominence 3.5% maximum flux; attacks restricted to 0.3-3.4 seconds. Regress attack time on integer index. Only Poly provides unconfounded timing in this small set.

Arp Bells.interpretation: Exploratory audible attack-flux estimate only; delay echoes or changing attack spectra shift peaks, so this is not a precise arp clock measurement.

Arp Bass.interpretation: Exploratory audible attack-flux estimate only; delay echoes or changing attack spectra shift peaks, so this is not a precise arp clock measurement.

reused_A15_evidence.scope: Pre-calibration development evidence; no new A28 run of pan/tremolo. Identical recipe/body/Engine hashes checked. Master calibration may differ.

motion.measurement: 20 ms RMS windows, 1.0-7.8 s, least-squares offset/trend plus sinusoid; frequency grid ±0.3 Hz in .005 Hz steps

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,csv,struct
import numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
from scipy.signal import find_peaks,welch
R=Path('/workspace/scratch/a9592b052b11/a28')

def db(x):return float(20*np.log10(max(float(x),1e-12)))
def load(p):
 rate,a=wavfile.read(p);assert rate==48000 and a.dtype==np.float32 and a.ndim==2 and a.shape[1]==2
 assert np.isfinite(a).all() and np.max(np.abs(a))<=1
 return a.astype(np.float64)
def envelope(a,seconds=.02):
 n=round(48000*seconds);rows=a[:len(a)//n*n].reshape(-1,n,2)
 return (np.arange(len(rows))+.5)*seconds,np.sqrt(np.mean(rows**2,axis=(1,2)))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def digest(vals):
 h=14695981039346656037
 for v in vals:
  for b in struct.pack('<f',v):h=((h^b)*1099511628211)&0xffffffffffffffff
 return f"{h:016x}"
inventory=json.loads((R/'inventory.json').read_text());programs={p['name']:p for p in inventory['programs']}
condition_rows=[]
for folder in ['nature','arp']:
 for row in csv.DictReader((R/folder/'metrics.csv').open()):
  assert str(row['parameter_digest'])==digest(programs[row['name']]['values']), (row['name'],row['parameter_digest'])
  condition_rows.append(row)
results={};waves=[]
for folder in ['nature','baseline-wind','arp']:
 for p in sorted((R/folder).glob('*.wav')):
  a=load(p);waves.append(dict(file=str(p.relative_to(R)),frames=len(a),sha256=sha(p),peak_dbfs=db(np.max(np.abs(a)))))
  t,e=envelope(a)
  if folder in ['nature','baseline-wind']:
   held=np.sqrt(np.mean(a[8*48000:int(9.5*48000)]**2))
   selected=(t>=2.5)&(t<9.8);tt=t[selected]-6.15;yy=20*np.log10(np.maximum(e[selected],1e-12))
   X=np.column_stack([np.ones(len(tt)),tt,tt**2,np.sin(2*np.pi*.7*tt),np.cos(2*np.pi*.7*tt)])
   beta=np.linalg.lstsq(X,yy,rcond=None)[0];res=yy-X@beta
   cov=(res@res/(len(yy)-X.shape[1]))*np.linalg.inv(X.T@X)
   amp=float(np.hypot(*beta[-2:]));grad=beta[-2:]/max(amp,1e-20)
   se=float(np.sqrt(grad@cov[-2:,-2:]@grad))
   f,power=welch(a[48000:2*48000].mean(axis=1),fs=48000,nperseg=4096)
   centroid=float((f@power)/max(power.sum(),1e-30))
   results[f'{folder}/{p.stem}']=dict(crest_seconds=float(t[np.argmax(e)]),late_held_vs_crest_db=db(held/np.max(e)),centroid_1_to_2_seconds_hz=centroid)
   if p.stem.endswith('-Wind'):
    results[f'{folder}/{p.stem}']['periodic_0_7_hz_peak_to_peak_db']=2*amp
  else:
   name=next(n for n in ['Arp Poly','Arp Bells','Arp Bass'] if n.replace(' ','-') in p.stem)
   rate={'Arp Poly':8.,'Arp Bells':4.,'Arp Bass':6.}[name]
   tt,ee=envelope(a,.002)
   flux=np.maximum(np.diff(ee,prepend=ee[0]),0)
   loc,properties=find_peaks(flux,distance=round(.72/rate/.002),prominence=float(flux.max())*.035)
   loc=loc[(tt[loc]>=.3)&(tt[loc]<3.4)]
   times=tt[loc]
   intervals=np.diff(times)
   period=float(np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack([np.ones(len(times)),np.arange(len(times))]),times,rcond=None)[0][1])
   results[name]=dict(expected_rate_hz=rate,detected_rate_hz=1/period,detected_onset_seconds=times.tolist(),interval_seconds_min=float(min(intervals)),interval_seconds_max=float(max(intervals)),onsets=len(times))
report={'measurements':results,'waves':waves,'capture_conditions':condition_rows,'total_seconds':sum(w['frames'] for w in waves)/48000,'finite_samples':sum(w['frames']*2 for w in waves),'max_peak_dbfs':max(w['peak_dbfs'] for w in waves)}
(R/'measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ['waves','capture_conditions']},indent=2))

limits: Seven selected current programs and one baseline program, one pitch and velocity at 48 kHz; this is neither a full-bank sweep nor all-host/all-platform qualification.
No listening-panel result, recorded-instrument comparison or hyperrealism equivalence claim.
Single held note exercises arp retriggering and octave cycling; multi-note mode ordering was source-reviewed, not independently chord-rendered here.
No 0.7 Hz periodic fit is interpreted for decaying Surf/Thunder: decay and noise-floor crossings confound that method.
Spectral centroids and RMS time courses are diagnostic descriptions, not independent proof of natural weather realism.
